resources.string: Sends your daily steps and weight from Health Connect to Forza!, a few times a day. Nothing else is read.
Connected. Allow access to steps and weight.
Open Forza! on this phone → Settings → Connect Health & scale → "Connect the helper".
Sent %1$d days of steps and %2$d weigh-ins.
The sync key is no longer valid. Connect the helper again from Forza!.
Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Your steps and weight will be sent to %1$s. Only connect if you opened this link from your own Forza! app.
Eufy scale: in the EufyLife app, turn on Health Connect (or Google Fit) for weight. Forza! then gets every weigh-in automatically.

Forza! Health reads only: daily step count, body weight and body fat percentage from Health Connect.

The data is sent over an encrypted connection to the Forza! server set up by your family administrator, where it is visible only to you and to that administrator. It is used only to show your progress in the Forza! app. Nothing is sold or shared.

You can remove access at any time in Health Connect settings, or uninstall this app.
